arm: ima0 (arm tag taken from the run name; arm semantics not re-verified)

selection.criterion: teacher checkpoint at epoch 277 of run abl026 (PH2 validation Dice from summary.json best_teacher_ph2_validation_dice). This checkpoint is the model reported in the thesis (abl026 teacher), evaluated on ISIC2018 (2594 images) with Dice, IoU and HD95. Patient independence was not verified (thesis report: holdout_status independence_not_verified).
selection.candidates_note: Only this run is listed; other runs were not compared in this release.

input.name: pixel_values
input.range: [0,1] RGB, after hair removal and /255; ImageNet normalisation is inside the graph
preprocessing_required: hair removal: cv2 black-hat (kernel 9 ellipse, threshold 10) + Telea inpaint radius 3, shaped=False

postprocess: raw: sigmoid -> uint8 -> bilinear resize to the original H,W -> /255 -> >= 0.5. No morphology, no largest component, no hole filling. Thesis report for this checkpoint: hair_removal true, hair_shaped false, vignette_mask false, largest_component false, fill_holes false, center_prior false, slic_contrast_refinement_enabled false.

licenses.dermlip: CC-BY-NC-ND-4.0, used only during training-time calibration, not at inference

isic2018_2594.evaluated_model: teacher (abl026), torch checkpoint, thesis evaluation; the ONNX file was not re-evaluated on the full set in this release
isic2018_2594.caveat: Numbers from the thesis report isic_report.json (torch checkpoint, frozen evaluator, raw path). ONNX parity was measured on 24 images only.

parity.reference: standalone segmenter_model.py torch vs ONNX, shipped runners (verify_package.py)

latency_cpu.note: shared host, load average ~3.3 during the run
